reference_policy: Source observation-day wording is normalized at runtime to the next-day midnight. Raw QA stays unchanged; qa_reference_times.json and load_data.py provide the canonical model reference time.
event_availability_policy: Game on day d is assumed available at dayzero + d + 1 days; historical inputs include availability <= reference_time. No source publication timestamps exist.
sampling_policy: Seed-42 hash partition of real anchor IDs across QA/support splits; historical eligibility; approximately balanced SQL-defined outcome strata; spread anchors/seasons/numeric values; no repeated bound SQL; record scarce strata and never fabricate/replace undefined results with zero.
qualifier_policy: Preserve primary wording and replace only team identity, season and explicit calendar dates. Exclude unverified factual premises, nontransferable round equivalences and fixed-day SQL misdescribed as chronological first game.
head_training_policy: Train/adapt on support/train; select on support/validation; evaluate the frozen merged Prediction population.
support_count_policy: Up to ten per parent. If a classification role exceeds 60/40 after real candidate selection, downsample the majority toward 50/50 while retaining five examples per parent where available; the release arrays contain the retained instances.
qa_split_policy: Preserve question IDs and original split membership; replace prediction anchors, canonical wording and actual SQL labels. Nonprediction QA unchanged. Anchor IDs are disjoint across splits; this is not an unseen-template split.
original_qa_prediction_policy: Outcome-stratified diagnostic evaluation, not natural-population prevalence. Rebuilt prediction paraphrase lists are empty to avoid stale entity/season aliases.
test_support_policy: Train/adapt on support/train; select on support/validation; evaluate the frozen merged Prediction population.
prediction_training_policy: Train/adapt on support/train; select on support/validation; evaluate the frozen merged Prediction population.
